offers.level: community unit/floor-plan feed; exact unit number not supplied

description: 2 bed / 1 bath mobile home with in-unit laundry room. Conveniently located at Kings Mobile Home Park, off 192, close to Disney, downtown Kissimmee and Shingle Creek Park. Includes kitchen appliances, water, and landscaping. The lease will allow two vehicles maximum due to limited driveway parking space. Beware of rental scams: We never request any payment before you personally view the home. We do not offer self-showings or provide lockbox codes. LEASE TERMS: - First month's rent and $900 deposit due at signing - $28 monthly garbage collection fee (in addition to rent) - One-year lease - $40 application fee - Included in the rent: Water, Landscaping APPLICATION CRITERIA: - Household income 3x the monthly rent ($2700 or more) - Good references, no evictions, clean background, no smoking, no cosigners - No pets accepted All applicants are subject to a credit check, rental history verification, background screening, and employment verification.
